name: SpaceNet 6: Multi-Sensor All-Weather Mapping (SAR & Optical)
description: SpaceNet 6 is an advanced multimodal remote sensing challenge dataset developed by SpaceNet LLC, Capella Space, and Maxar Technologies to benchmark building footprint extraction under all-weather conditions using synthetic aperture radar (SAR) and electro-optical (EO) satellite imagery. Focused over the port of Rotterdam, Netherlands (AOI 11, covering roughly 120 km²), the dataset contains 4,251 tiles of 900x900 pixels (~450m x 450m), divided into 3,401 training tiles (39.0 GB, containing paired SAR, optical, and building labels) and approximately 850 testing tiles (16.9 GB, containing SAR-only imagery). Sensor modalities include 0.5-meter X-band quad-polarization SAR (HH, HV, VH, VV) provided by Capella Space aerial sensor platforms and 0.5-meter optical imagery from Maxar's WorldView-2 satellite. Ground truth provides polygon annotations for approximately 48,000 building footprints in GeoJSON format.

verification.notes: Verified against spacenet.ai/sn6-challenge/, registry.opendata.aws/spacenet/, arXiv:2004.06500, and TorchGeo documentation. Reconciled sample breakdown: 3,401 training tiles (paired Capella SAR + WorldView-2 EO + building labels, 39.0 GB) and ~850 public testing tiles (SAR-only, 16.9 GB) totaling 4,251 public release tiles (55.9 GB payload). Challenge organizers held out a private test set (~850 tiles) for leaderboard scoring. Single-modality loaders like TorchGeo (SpaceNet6) filter by imagery type (e.g. SAR-Intensity or optical PS-RGB). Verified ~48,000 building footprint polygons over Rotterdam (AOI 11) and CC BY-SA 4.0 terms.

size.notes: Full release payload totals 55.9 GB on AWS S3 (`s3://spacenet-dataset/spacenet/SN6_buildings/`): 39.0 GB training data (3,401 paired SAR and EO tiles with GeoJSON labels) and 16.9 GB public testing data (~850 SAR-only tiles). Also includes an untiled WorldView-2 optical image spanning ~92 km² at 0.5m GSD.
